newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Toyota says talk of BMW bid a rumour.
newsitem.headline: Toyota says talk of BMW bid a rumour.

text.p: Japanese car-maker Toyota Motor Corp on Monday dismissed as rumour a suggestion that it was interested in buying control of German luxury car-maker BMW AG.
"I think such kind of news, especially about BMW ... is rumours," Toyota president Hiroshi Okuda said when asked about newspaper speculation the Japanese giant wanted half of BMW.

The British monthly "Car" magazine reported in its September edition that secret talks had begun for the sale of a 50 percent stake held in BMW by the Quandt family. The report cited Toyota and U.S. car-maker Chrysler Corp as the leading bidders.
BMW denied the report early this month.
Okuda was speaking on Monday at a news conference in Melbourne to announce an expansion of Toyota's Australian operations.
